direct.label: ZMR direct (hand-sent)
direct.note: One-to-one forwards off Kevin's 21 Sep memo, then a second wave on 12 Oct to every name Kirsh had proposed but never mailed, then a third wave the same evening off ZMR's own equity list (1,087 contacts on Drive) and the Canyon Woods reply record. All three waves are out — 54 firms on 12 Oct alone, the last at 22:25. A fourth wave of bumps went 15-16 Oct and a fifth on 21-22 Oct (14 firms between 20:03 and 20:09 ET, then Pearlmark and Integrity by hand the next morning). Six follow-ups are written and sitting in drafts: Grandview, West Pine, Benedict, STRE, Parse and Capital Solutions. Each email opens on that firm's own last answer to us where one exists. Subject throughout: "Houston 2023 Vintage $135K/door $13M Check 20%+ IRR".

kirsh.label: Andrew Kirsh
kirsh.note: Kirsh sent to Tramview on 2 Oct, then to the three groups Zamir said he did not know — Mile Rock, Green Pine and Range Equity — on the morning of 3 Oct. All four came back. The rest of his list he raised as a question and never confirmed sending. Argosy was pulled from his list because Zamir knows them and went direct; they passed on 7 Oct.

slocumb.label: Jeremy Slocumb
slocumb.note: Jeremy Slocumb at IPA took seven names on 5 Oct and was cleared to send on 7 Oct, minus Grandview, Long Wharf and Mountain Pacific, which Zamir held back because he knows them. He reported back on 15 Oct: three reviewing, three declined, Nelnet still out. That report is the first hard confirmation that the send happened - IPA holds the send record, we never did. He is pushing 621 Capital himself.

rjl.label: RJL Capital Advisors
rjl.note: Livi's engagement letter of 22 Oct listed 34 groups and claimed a 2% fee, a 30-day exclusive and a non-circumvention over all of them. Zamir narrowed it by email on 26 Oct - "confirmed you are OK to send to the 11 groups i mentioned below and the terms do not apply to the groups i carved out" - and Livi did not push back. That email is the governing scope. RJL sent to the eleven and holds the addresses and the send record; we have neither. Their first written progress report came back 29 Oct 15:48 UTC, four hours after Zamir asked what feedback they had, with the covering line "just waiting on feedback and some potential around a hybrid pref structure." Their dated notes run from 27 Oct, so the deal was out on or before then. The eleven are covered by a non-disclosure clause: do not name them to any third party, Ackman-Ziff included.

familyoffice.label: Family office blast
familyoffice.note: A GMass merge to 634 family offices off the FinTrx-sourced fo_SEND list, sent 26 Oct 14:34 PDT under "Depreciation | Houston 2023 Vintage | $135K/Door | $12M Equity | 21.5% IRR", with a stage-one follow-up to the 330 who had not answered on 29 Oct. This is the only channel on the board that is a true blast: nobody here was hand-picked and most had never heard of ZMR. It returned 12 replies, 1.89%, against 4.55% on the PE send the same week from the same mailbox - and four of the eleven recorded replies are firms that do not invest in direct real estate at all, so the gap is list quality rather than message.

peblast.label: PE / institutional send
peblast.note: The remainder of ZMR's own equity list, screened to v5 and sent 29 Oct 16:15 PDT as "Houston 2023 Vintage | +LTO | $135K/Door | $12M Equity | 21% IRR". 328 addresses went in, GMass suppressed 42 as prior bounces, 286 delivered in 42 minutes. 13 replies inside the first four hours - 4.55%, the best rate of any channel - but seven of them are size passes, which says the list still needs a check-size floor before the next wave.

ypo.label: YPO deal flow chat
ypo.note: A single post to the YPO deal flow group chat, not a merge and not a list. It is the only channel on the board where the audience self-selects: nobody was targeted, and anyone who comes back has raised their own hand. Reach counts named respondents rather than chat members, since we hold no roster: Alberto Bonilla at Garnier on 1 Nov and Stephen Lobell at JSB on 2 Nov, both of whom raised their own hand. The cheque profile is the inverse of every other channel - YPO members write individual cheques, where nine firms have now passed here because $11.77M was below their floor.

sfo.label: Rest of SFO (single family offices)
sfo.note: The 'Rest of SFO not sent previously' list - roughly 600 single family offices sourced from FinTrx, sent 3 Nov under the new subject 'Houston Multifamily LP Equity' with three bullets no other wave carried: Year 1 CoC 11%, Depreciation, and Accept 1031 Exchange. Reach is not yet fixed because the send was still running when Gmail throttled the account. This wave bounced at least 22 addresses in its first few hours and triggered eleven 'you have reached a limit for sending mail' failures, one of which killed an unrelated reply to Rialto Capital.

windmass.label: Mitchell Voss (WindMass)
windmass.owner: Mitchell Voss, Founder & CEO, WindMass Capital
windmass.note: Zamir asked Voss on 2 November - a Dallas competitor, not a broker - 'do you know any groups this deal might be a fit for', and attached the OM and the full model. Voss sat on it for eight days and then, between 19:30 and 19:56 on 10 November, forwarded it to four firms with a personal note on each: Connor Monaghan at Arcapita, Meredith at Machine Investment Group, Michael Pokorny and Katie Harris at Cerberus, and Jawad Ahmed at Farallon. Zamir was copied on every one. Cerberus answered 78 seconds after the introduction landed. This is the first channel on the board opened by a competitor rather than a broker or a list, and it is the only one whose names are all institutional. It also carries the live underwriting model (Houston_TX_SmartLivingAllenGenoa_ZMR_PF_10.26.26.xlsx) out to four firms at once - Zamir attached it himself on 2 Nov, so that was his call, but it is now in four more hands.
